result.question: What does Elisha tell elders to do?

readings.answer: Shut the door to keep the messenger out.
readings.support: Look, when the messenger comes, shut the door to keep him out.

assessments.reason: Elisha says, “when the messenger comes, shut the door to keep him out,” which conveys shutting and holding the door closed.
“Look” is only an attention-getting imperative and omits the specific instruction to shut/hold the door given in “shut the door to keep him out.”

result.reason: Verse 32 explicitly has Elisha tell the elders to shut the door to keep the messenger out, matching the key.
